body.zh: 先记住这颗蓝色星球。接下来它会越来越小，但定位十字始终追踪同一个位置。地球不是宇宙中心，只是这趟观察的起点。
body.en: Start with the blue planet. It will become smaller, but the crosshair follows the same location. Earth is not the center of the universe; it is the starting point of this journey.

boundary.zh: 球体使用真实半径，地表与云层来自静态地图，并非实时天气；光照为观察结构而安排。定位十字不是天体直径，画面中的光晕不用于量尺寸。
boundary.en: The sphere uses Earth’s physical radius, with static surface and cloud maps, not live weather. Lighting is arranged for viewing. Crosshairs and halos do not measure diameters.

body.zh: 轨道的尺度逐渐出现。现在地球和许多行星的真实圆盘小于一个像素，因此改用明确的定位符；没有偷偷把行星放大。天文单位 AU 是地球到太阳的平均距离量级。
body.en: The planetary orbits emerge. Earth and many planets now have subpixel physical disks, so explicit markers locate them without inflating their diameters. An astronomical unit, AU, is about the mean Earth–Sun distance.

boundary.zh: 圆轨道与相位为教学构图，不是某天的星历。轨道距离与实心圆盘共享 km 标尺；十字与空心定位圈另作符号。
boundary.en: Circular orbits and phases are illustrative, not an ephemeris. Orbital distances and solid disks share the km ruler; crosses and open circles are separate symbols.

title.zh: 恒星之间，隔着很长的路

body.zh: 太阳系已经缩成一个位置。光年是光在真空中一年走过的距离，不是时间单位。最近恒星邻居也在数光年之外；这段距离远远大于行星之间的距离。
body.en: The Solar System has shrunk to a location. A light-year is the distance light travels through vacuum in a year, not a unit of time. Even the nearest stellar neighbors are several light-years away, much farther than the distances between planets.

boundary.zh: 比邻星和天狼星标出取整距离，方向为教学排布。继续拉远时出现的未标名星点示意银河中的邻近恒星，不是逐星测量图，不能用来数真实恒星。星点为位置符号，不是等比例恒星大小。
boundary.en: Proxima and Sirius have rounded distances and illustrative directions. Unnamed points emerging farther out represent a local galactic population, not measured positions or a count of real stars. Points locate stars, not true-sized disks.

title.en: The Sun lives in the galactic disk

body.zh: 继续拉远，附近的星点渐隐，银河盘的整体形状逐渐显现。再转到侧面，看看它有多薄；中心有核球和棒，周围还有恒星晕。太阳距银河中心约 2.6 万光年。中心黑洞主要影响它附近的轨道，整个银河并不是一套围着黑洞转的巨大太阳系。
body.en: As the view pulls back, nearby star points fade and the galactic disk gradually takes shape. Rotate to the side to see how thin it is, with a central bulge and bar and a surrounding stellar halo. The Sun is about 26,000 light-years from the center. The central black hole dominates nearby orbits, not the whole galaxy as a giant Solar System.

boundary.zh: 附近星点因缩小而渐隐，不表示恒星消失。银河外观与星点分布是结构重建，不是从银河外拍摄的照片或逐星测量图。暗物质晕根据引力效应推断；打开它不表示我们直接看见了暗物质。
boundary.en: Nearby points fade as the view shrinks them; this does not mean the stars vanish. The external view and star distribution reconstruct galactic structure, not a photograph from outside or a star-by-star map. The dark-matter halo is inferred from gravity; showing it does not make it directly observed.

title.en: The Milky Way is one member

body.zh: 银河系、仙女座星系和三角座星系，与许多更小的星系组成了本星系群。银河系与仙女座相隔约 250 万光年。继续向外还有其他星系群和星系团；这张图不是宇宙的边界。
body.en: The Milky Way, Andromeda and Triangulum belong to the Local Group along with many smaller galaxies. Andromeda is about 2.5 million light-years away. Other groups and clusters lie beyond; this picture is not the edge of the universe.

boundary.zh: 三座较大星系使用取整距离与示意方位、倾角；发光盘可按标尺比较。小光圈只抽样表示其他成员，其位置不能用于测距，标记也不是星系尺寸；暗晕不等于盘的边缘。
boundary.en: The three larger galaxies use rounded distances and illustrative directions and inclinations; their luminous disks can be compared with the ruler. Small rings sample other members and their placements cannot be measured as distances. Markers are not galaxy sizes, and halos are not disk boundaries.

title.zh: 本星系群之外还有邻居
title.en: A neighboring cluster comes into view

body.zh: 镜头继续后退，本星系群缩成位置标记；约 5400 万光年外的室女座星系团进入画面。它是邻近的另一个结构，并不包含本星系群。
body.en: As the Local Group shrinks to a location marker, the Virgo Cluster appears about 54 million light-years away. It is a separate neighboring structure, not a container for the Local Group.

boundary.zh: 距离为取整量级，方向只是教学排布；星系团光点与淡蓝色热气体为结构示意，不能用标尺量它们的直径或数成员。
boundary.en: The distance is rounded and the direction is illustrative. Cluster points and pale blue hot gas are structural symbols; their diameters and member counts cannot be measured here.

title.zh: 群与团共享更大的区域
title.en: Groups and clusters share a wider region

body.zh: 继续拉远，室女座星系团与本星系群都落在拉尼亚凯亚超星系团的广大区域内。研究给出的跨度约 5.2 亿光年；本星系群靠近外围。
body.en: Farther out, Virgo and the Local Group lie in the wide Laniakea supercluster region. Its reported span is about 520 million light-years, with the Local Group near an outer edge.

boundary.zh: 虚线轮廓只表达约略跨度和所属区域，不是精确表面或引力墙。超星系团整体通常不被自身引力束缚。
boundary.en: The dashed outline conveys an approximate span and association, not an exact surface or gravitational wall. Superclusters are generally not bound as a whole.

title.zh: 更多结构沿丝状区域分布

body.zh: 同一镜头继续拉远，视野各处都出现星系群和星系团的丝状分布示意，之间有相对稀疏的空洞。画面逐渐从少数有距离依据的地标，转为展示大尺度分布形态。
body.en: As the same camera moves outward, an illustrative filamentary distribution of groups and clusters fills the view, with comparatively sparse voids between them. The view shifts from a few distance-anchored landmarks to a large-scale pattern.

boundary.zh: 丝线、结点和小光点是固定在连续镜头中的示意纹理，并非实测星系位置、实体绳索或可用标尺测量的宽度；这里不计算光行回溯时间。
boundary.en: Filaments, knots and points form a stable illustration in the continuous camera. They are not surveyed galaxy positions, physical ropes or widths measurable with the ruler; lookback time is not calculated.

title.zh: 观测边界不是宇宙的墙
title.en: Our observing horizon is not a wall

body.zh: 拉远到终点时，视野容得下直径至少约 930 亿光年的可观测范围。圆心只是我们的观测位置；圆外还有什么，不能从这张图推断。光在旅途中经历空间膨胀，所以今天的距离不能直接当作光传播的年数。
body.en: At the end of the outward journey, the view holds the observable region, at least about 93 billion light-years across. Its center marks our observing location, not the center of all space. Space expanded while light traveled, so today's distance is not the number of years that light traveled.

boundary.zh: 虚线圆按约 465 亿光年半径画出观测范围，不是宇宙边缘。近处丝线逐渐过渡到与结构路径终点相同的示意网；线、结点与细点并非全天实测星系图。黄色中心定位符表示我们所在的拉尼亚凯亚区域，不是其直径；这里不模拟膨胀或回溯时间。
boundary.en: The dashed circle sketches an observing range with an approximate 46.5-billion-light-year radius, not a physical edge. Nearby filaments transition into the same illustrative web used at the end of the structural address; its links, knots and fine points are not a measured all-sky galaxy map. The yellow central locator marks our Laniakea region, not its diameter. Expansion and lookback time are not simulated.

sceneNote.zh: 镜头连续拉远；球体、轨道和星盘使用同一距离标尺。远处丝线与光点是分布示意，空心圆与十字只定位，不代表大小。
sceneNote.en: One continuous zoom, with spheres, orbits and galactic disks sharing a distance ruler. Distant filaments and points illustrate distribution; open circles and crosses locate objects, not their sizes.

chooseOrigin.en: Choose a start (switching returns to close-up)

sizeFact.zh: 太阳的直径约是地球的 109 倍。
sizeFact.en: The Sun is about 109 Earth diameters across.

sizeNote.zh: 独立大小对比：两圆直径同比例，间隔不是日地距离；不使用主图标尺。
sizeNote.en: Separate size comparison: both diameters share a scale. Their spacing is not the Earth–Sun distance; this inset does not use the main ruler.

sizeHint.zh: 主图拉远后，太阳也会小到看不清。空心圈只用来找位置。
sizeHint.en: As the main view widens, even the Sun becomes too small to resolve. Open circles only mark locations.

title.en: Meet the Sun before moving outward

body.zh: 先记住这颗恒星的圆盘，再一路拉远，看行星轨道怎样进入画面。太阳直径约 139 万千米，是地球的约 109 倍；但它和行星轨道之间的距离相比，仍然很小。
body.en: Remember this stellar disk, then move outward as planetary orbits enter the view. The Sun is about 1.39 million km across, roughly 109 Earth diameters, yet small compared with planetary orbital distances.

boundary.zh: 太阳圆盘与距离使用同一千米标尺，表面颜色和颗粒为示意。地球仍在约一个天文单位之外，没有被搬到太阳旁边。
boundary.en: The solar disk and distances use one kilometer ruler; surface colors and granules are illustrative. Earth remains about one AU away, not moved beside the Sun.
